Harbourline Summit 2026: attendee FAQ

Who can see the attendee directory?
Every registered attendee with a Full Conference pass can view, sort, and filter the attendee list inside the Harbourline app. Expo-only passes do not include the directory.

What does the directory show?
Each entry shows name, job title, company and country. A photo is optional.

Can I hide my profile?
Yes. You can hide your profile from the directory in your account settings at any time.

Can I download the list?
No. The list cannot be downloaded, exported or printed by attendees or sponsors. It can only be browsed in the app.

What do sponsors get?
Sponsors receive lead retrieval for the badges they scan at their own booth. We do not share or sell the attendee list.
